description: Absence rule (#50): fires when NO decisions of any kind (any augmentloop.grade.source, any score label - a total pipeline halt, not a quality dip) have been graded for 10 consecutive 1-minute evaluations (absentFor=10 @ frequency=1m = 10 minutes of silence). N=10m rationale: each toy-world/build-fleet replay batch completes in seconds, so short natural gaps between runs must not trip this; the Gradebook design target for LIVE mode is ~3k model calls/day (~1 every ~30s on average per docs/conventions.md Section 11), so 10 minutes of total silence is roughly 20x the expected inter-decision gap even allowing for bursty, non-uniform arrival - comfortably beyond noise, well short of a full incident going unnoticed. Uses increase/sum with NO grade-source filter, deliberately looser than the headline math+reality scope, because 'is the pipeline alive at all' should catch ai_judge-only activity too. QUERY WINDOW NOTE: verified live against this deployment (2026-07-25) that increase()/rate() on gradebook.decisions.graded returns real data for short windows (up to ~3h) but silently returns null for 6h+ windows regardless of groupBy - evalWindow is kept at 1m (well inside the working range) for exactly this reason. SCHEMA NOTE: the live API rejects a threshold_rule with alertOnAbsent as the sole condition (schemaVersion v2alpha1 requires condition.thresholds + notificationSettings; the v1 shape requires condition.target/op/matchType regardless) - confirmed by two rejected POSTs, not assumed. The companion threshold below (op=below, target=0) is a structural no-op: a count-of-decisions metric can never go below 0, so it can never itself fire: alertOnAbsent+absentFor is the sole EFFECTIVE trigger, the threshold exists only to satisfy the API contract. HONESTY NOTE (fire-and-recover): the grading pipeline is not continuously running in this hackathon environment - replay batches are triggered manually - so silence is the natural resting state. This rule was created while the pipeline was already silent; see the accompanying report for the actual polled/observed evidence of firing and (if within the session's time budget) recovery, stated honestly rather than assumed.

annotations.description: No decisions have been graded (any augmentloop.grade.source) for at least 10 minutes - the grading pipeline may have stalled or crashed. (Threshold shown, target 0, is a structural no-op per rule description; the real trigger is alertOnAbsent.)
annotations.summary: Gradebook grading pipeline silent for 10+ minutes
